label: Done-for-you Kindle publishing

steps.title: Extract the manuscript to clean text
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: convert jobs/{{job_id}}/manuscript to clean text, keeping headings, lists, images and footnotes; list anything unreadable.

steps.title: Rights and content check
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: check the manuscript for third-party text or images, trademarks and medical/financial claims; list every question the client must answer before we publish.

steps.title: Edit pass 1: mechanics
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: edit for grammar, punctuation, spelling and consistency (names, tense, numbers); produce a tracked-changes copy and a clean copy. Keep the author's voice.

steps.title: Edit pass 2: readability
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: suggest structure, chapter-flow and repetition fixes as comments only; never rewrite the author's voice.

steps.title: Client review of the edits
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: send the tracked changes to the client (each send is approved by the captain).

steps.title: Front and back matter
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: draft the title page, copyright page, table of contents, about the author and call to action.

steps.title: Format the ebook
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: build an EPUB with real heading styles, a linked table of contents and inline images with alt text.

steps.title: Format the paperback
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: build the paperback interior PDF at the exact trim size, margins at least 0.5in with a larger gutter; report the page count for the spine.

steps.title: Three cover directions
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: propose 3 {{genre}} cover directions with image prompts (no AI-drawn text; title and author are set with real type afterwards). Ebook 2560x1600 px; paperback 300 DPI full wrap with 0.125in bleed.

steps.title: Client picks a cover direction
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: send the 3 cover directions to the client.

steps.title: Metadata pack
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: write the title/subtitle, sales description, up to 7 keywords, categories and the 35%/70% royalty options explained. The client sets the price.

steps.title: AI disclosure sheet
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: list what is AI-generated (must be disclosed to KDP, e.g. an AI cover) versus AI-assisted (editing, no disclosure).

steps.title: KDP setup guide
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: write the step-by-step guide for the client's OWN KDP account (we never hold their credentials): create title, details, content, pricing.

steps.title: Final QA by a different model family
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: open every deliverable and check TOC links, images, cover legibility at thumbnail size, and the spelling of the title and author. Report pass/fail per file.

steps.title: The client clicks Publish
steps.intent: Job {{job_id}}: the client publishes from their own KDP account.
